state.seed_assertion: The first-out fault should be captured with a timestamp and not overwritten until authorized reset.

sentences.1: The first-out fault should be captured with a timestamp and not overwritten until authorized reset.
sentences.2: Preserve the first event Secondary alarms can appear milliseconds after the initiating condition.
sentences.3: Capture the first-out fault with a timestamp and do not overwrite it until an authorized reset.
sentences.4: In the Peakboard Hub, machine states can be stored with a timestamp to make availability, downtime durations and OEE measurable across weeks and months.
sentences.5: In the Peakboard Hub, machine states can be stored with a timestamp.
sentences.6: Processor reset registers can indicate the type of reset cause and provide valuable diagnostic information for narrowing down the fault source.
sentences.7: It also turned out the processor in our drive held a register for determining what caused the reset, which indicated an illegal address rather than one of four other possible other causes.
